messages:
Olivia Park: quick design review note from today's usability run: users keep missing pinned rows in Compact density. They assume pinning vanished. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/compact-pin-miss.png :thinking:
Marcus Chen: saw that too. in compact the badges column collapses and the pin glyph is hidden. We need a persistent affordance that survives density collapse
Sophie Lin: options: (A) small left accent stripe, (B) 4px dot at row-start, (C) tiny always-on pin glyph (size limited). My vote is stripe + hover reveal of the full pin icon
Diego Ramos: stripe is low-noise but we must check contrast. If 2px stripe fails contrast we should bump to 3-4px. Also add a non-color fallback (dot or small shape) for colorblind/monochrome displays
designbot: Accessibility reminder: any persistent indicator must have an accessible name. Add aria-roledescription="pinned row" on the row and the pin control must expose aria-pressed="true" when pinned. Verify stripe contrast >= 3:1 or increase width
Olivia Park: also two related issues: (1) performance badge tooltip gets clipped by action chevrons in tight rows, and (2) the tooltip disappears too quickly for screen reader users when they tab to the badge
Marcus Chen: about (1) the action chevrons are rendered into a separate portal which creates stacking context issues. Quick fix: set the action portal z-index lower than the global tooltip layer or render badges/actions in the same stacking context
Sophie Lin: for (2) we should not rely on visual tooltips for SR. Add aria-describedby on the badge with the full text: "Performance 91 — latency 110ms, est $0.0018/token". Keep tooltip visual-only and add a 100ms show delay + 200ms hide delay to reduce flicker
Diego Ramos: implementation note: increasing chevron hit area is low-risk: .chevron { padding: 6px; margin: -6px; } keeps visual density but makes targets 24px. I'll include that in the patch
Olivia Park: microcopy change: replace "Perf: 0.91" with inline "Perf 91" and in the hover card show two lines: "latency: 110ms" and "est cost: $0.0018/tk". Update tokens/components/tooltip/strings.ts accordingly
designbot: Recommended PR checklist: 1) portal z-index fix + tooltip delay, 2) chevron hit target >=24px, 3) aria-describedby on perf badge, 4) persistent pin indicator + aria-roledescription, 5) contrast check for stripe, 6) keyboard order test (checkbox -> pin -> badge -> actions), 7) storybook axe run
Marcus Chen: I'll open a draft PR with the z-index and padding changes, include visual snapshots and a tabbable test. Will also add a short e2e that scrolls a virtualized list and hovers a badge to assert no jumping
Sophie Lin: I'll update Figma to show stripe variants and the hover reveal animation. Also adding the microcopy strings in the design tokens doc
Diego Ramos: tagging @eng-frontend for review. I'll attach the CSS snippet I tested in sandbox:
```​.catalog-row .action-portal { z-index: 900; }
.global-tooltip-layer { z-index: 1000; }
.chevron { padding: 6px; margin: -6px; min-width: 24px; min-height: 24px; }
.tooltip { transition-delay: 100ms; transition-duration: 120ms; }
```
Olivia Park: thanks team. once PR is up i'll run a quick usability check with compact rows and post results here. If stripe contrast fails we fallback to the dot + icon on focus.
